summary: Import-time shell-RC persistence via obfuscated internal-API spawn
details: On require(), @atedone/workspace-context@0.0.12 mutates the installer's shell startup files without user consent. index.js calls state.initialize() at load, which writes ~/.workspace-context/shell-init.sh and appends a sourcing line ('[ -f "$HOME/.workspace-context/shell-init.sh" ] &&. "$HOME/.workspace-context/shell-init.sh"') to ~/.bashrc and ~/.zshrc, so the package-controlled script executes on every future interactive shell. The child process that performs this work is launched through process.binding('spawn_sync').spawn via Reflect.apply, with the strings 'binding', 'spawn_sync', and 'spawn' reconstructed from character-array joins in state.js — a Node internal binding path that bypasses the public child_process API and evades keyword-based scanners. The combination of import-time persistence into the installer's shell initialization and obfuscated internal-API process spawning gives the publisher a durable code-execution foothold on the installer's host that is retriggered on every shell session and can be repurposed through any future package update.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
